headline: Where Could UnitedHealth's Next Growth Come From?
summary: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) could find its next growth engine in the care it delivers. That perspective carries weight right now. During the company's October 13 call, management raised its 2026 outlook to adjusted earnings per share of at least $20.50. Yet executives also warned that medical costs remain stubbornly high across health care. So which part of UnitedHealth's care business still has room to grow.
